name: ArenaTableSort
description: Which column the rows are ordered by, and which way. Controlled: ArenaTable draws the affordance and sets aria-sort, and the consumer does the ordering, because ArenaTable does not hold the rows and pretending otherwise would be the error. Absent, no header is a sort target however many columns declare `sortable`.

column.description: Which column, as its index in `columns`. An index rather than a key, because an ArenaTable's cells are already positional -- the nth ArenaTableCell takes the nth column -- so the index is the identity a column already has, and the optional `key` names a column's properties, not its identity.

direction.description: Which way that column is ordered.
